$comment: LD-205 capability tiers. This file is the single source: the extension reads it at runtime, the trust centre publishes it, and a test asserts it matches manifest.json. Editing the manifest without editing this fails the build.

tiers.name: Import assistance
tiers.capability: Notices when a data export finishes downloading and offers to hand it to your vault.
tiers.reason: Seeing that a file was saved needs the downloads permission. It reveals the file name and where it came from, not what you browse.

tiers.name: Tracker insight
tiers.capability: Shows which companies collect data as you browse, analysed on this device, and sends Global Privacy Control on your behalf.
tiers.granted: Separate opt-in, with a browser permission prompt
tiers.reason: Identifying who collects from a page needs to see which sites you visit, run a reader in the page, and attach an opt-out header to requests. That is why it is off until you turn it on, and why turning it off removes the permission rather than setting a flag.

tiers.name: Browsing contribution
tiers.capability: Lets you sell sanitized browsing data through the marketplace.
tiers.granted: Separate opt-in. Never bundled with tracker insight
tiers.reason: This is a commercial decision, not a privacy feature, so it is asked for on its own. Turning on tracker insight never turns this on.
